# Streamtime

Streamtime is project management software for creative businesses including design studios, agencies, and architects. It offers job tracking, time tracking, scheduling, quoting, invoicing, and team collaboration tools.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/streamtime/.

## Actions

- **Get Organisation Details** (read-only): Retrieve your organisation’s details.
- **Get Role** (read-only): Retrieve a role by id.
- **List Roles** (read-only): List all roles.
- **List Saved Segments for User** (read-only): List saved segments for a user.
